personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every area, collect all 5 coins, the gems, relics, keys and hearts, open every locked door and finish the level with the correct time bonus.
personas.style: Walks with goto: macros between item clusters, checks the HUD after each pickup, and tracks coins, keys and the score so that the final tally matches the state.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit or other areas early or by unintended routes: dash through gates and locked doors, step onto levers, cross spikes and enemies, and try to finish without the keys.
personas.style: Uses dash-* tokens against walls and closed doors, stands on the lever and presses use repeatedly, and tries to reach the exit before collecting the keys or coins. It keeps a record of every position it reaches.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break the timing of transitions: pause, resume, restart, and quit during pickups, hits, dashes, invulnerability and level completion, with several keys in the same tick.
personas.style: Sends combined tokens such as pause+left, down+right, esc+enter and click:btn-resume in quick succession. Spams input during the dialogs and checks that the frozen timer, dash recharge and toast stay unchanged.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each sentence literally, for example that the start is (1,1), that spikes cost 500 points, that a dash stops before a locked door, and that a heart gives +500 at 5 lives.
personas.style: Works through the document in order, performs one specified action per sentence, and records a pass or fail for each. It avoids improvising and does not skip any section.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Push the counters to their limits and check each amount: score at zero after spikes, score near the 999,999 cap, lives at 0 and 5, timer at 1 and 300, dash at 0 and 6, coins at 5 of 5, and the time bonus.
personas.style: Drives repeated spikes and hits to reach zero lives, collects hearts at 5 lives, and waits near the timer limit. After every tick it compares the HUD text (Score, Lives, Keys, Coins n/5, Time, Dash) with the state.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Game over, Level complete, victory) and check what is shown and what can be clicked, including overlaps and hidden buttons.
personas.style: Goes into each mode and reads the UI list. For each visible button it checks the text, the rectangle and whether top is true, then clicks it. It confirms that a click on a hidden or covered button does nothing.

checks.rule: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
At 0 lives the game is over (Game over dialog with Retry), so the game is not playing with 0 lives.
The level has 5 coins; coins collected never exceed 5 and never exceed the total.
The HUD always shows the current score.
The HUD always shows the current lives.
The HUD always shows the current keys.
The HUD shows Coins n/5 with the current coin count.
The dash status shows Dash ready at 0 and Dash n otherwise, where n is the ticks until ready.
The timer starts at 300 and when it reaches 0 the life is lost and the timer resets to 300.
A dash sets the recharge to 6, and it counts down at the end of the running tick, so right after a dash the HUD shows Dash 5.
If the very first tile of a dash is solid the dash does not happen and is not used up.
The player makes at most one move per tick: a step (1 tile) or a dash (up to 2 tiles in a straight line).
checks.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

checks.rule: Walls are solid: the player never stands on a wall, and a locked door is solid to a dash.
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D'

checks.rule: A gate is solid while closed and floor while open.
When the game becomes paused, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing moves that tick.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft

checks.rule: While paused nothing moves; timer, dash recharge and toasts are frozen.
checks.expect: cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.toast == prev.state.toast && cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y

checks.rule: While playing no dialog is open.
Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.
Restart level puts the level back to its starting state (score 0, 3 lives, all items back) and the game is running again straight away.
Items disappear when collected and never come back except on a restart.
checks.expect: cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins && cur.state.gems >= prev.state.gems && cur.state.relics >= prev.state.relics

checks.rule: Score only drops by spike damage (500, floored at 0); coins, gems and relics never lower it.
Spikes cost one life and always hurt, even right after a respawn.
Touching an enemy costs one life and no points.
Enemies cannot hurt the player during the tick of reappearing or the next 4 ticks.
After losing a life you reappear at the start (1, 1).
Enemies move one tile at a time, and at most every other tick.
checks.expect: all(cur.state.enemies, e => abs(e.x - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).x) + abs(e.y - find(prev.state.enemies, p => p.id == e.id).y) <= 1)

checks.rule: Completing the level adds a time bonus of 10 points per tick left on the timer.

verdicts.title: Hit that causes a respawn flagged by a check that misreads the rule
verdicts.observed: At tick 4 the enemy hit the player (inv was 0 beforehand) and the player respawned at (1,1) with inv=4 in the same tick. The check also requires no 'respawn' event, which every lethal hit produces.
verdicts.expected: A hit that costs a life sends the player to (1,1) and sets invulnerable to 4. That is correct behaviour, so this is a false positive.

verdicts.title: Pause menu Resume button covered and not clickable
verdicts.observed: When paused at tick 21, the btn-resume button reports top=false, so something else (the 'Key collected' toast is still on screen) sits on top of it and a click would not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable with nothing covering it, so Resume must be the topmost element at its centre while the pause menu is open.

verdicts.title: Timer reset by Restart flagged as a frozen-while-paused violation
verdicts.observed: The timer went from 299 to 300 and the event was 'restart'. The check fired because it did not exclude the restart, which resets the level by design.
verdicts.expected: Restart is allowed to reset the timer, so the frozen-while-paused rule should not apply to that tick. The check is wrong here, though the paused-after-restart symptom is a separate bug (candidate 3).

verdicts.title: Restart leaves the game paused with no dialog, so input is stuck
verdicts.observed: After pause then click btn-restart, the state stays mode=paused with no pause dialog or button shown in the UI list. Waiting does nothing and the state is frozen for 30+ ticks.
verdicts.expected: Restart puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away, so mode should be playing and the player can act.

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after a coin is collected
verdicts.observed: After dash-down+use, the state reports coins=1 and the coin was collected (score 100), but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current values, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Spike damage underflows the score into large positive and negative values
verdicts.observed: Score was 100 when spikes hit. Instead of flooring at 0, the score became 65136 (a 16-bit wraparound of 100-500), and later went to -300 after a coin, which violates the 0 to 999,999 range.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so it should be 0 after the spike, and it must always stay within 0 to 999,999.

verdicts.title: Two movement keys in one tick move the player 3 tiles (down then dash-down)
verdicts.observed: Tick 0 with tokens down+dash-down moved the player from (1,1) to (1,4), a 3-tile displacement. The earlier 'down' step was applied in addition to the dash.
verdicts.expected: Only the last movement key counts (dash-down), so the player makes at most one move (a dash of up to 2 tiles). Expected position is (1,3).

verdicts.title: Input after pause in the same tick still moves the player
verdicts.observed: Tokens pause+right paused the game, but the player moved from (1,1) to (2,1) in that tick (events: pause, move).
verdicts.expected: When the game becomes paused, the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing moves. The player should stay at (1,1).

verdicts.title: Level-complete Finish button is covered by the bonus banner
verdicts.observed: After completing the level, the Finish button (btn-next) is visible but top=false, meaning another element (the 'Time bonus' banner) sits on top of its centre, so clicks do not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover it. Finish should receive clicks on the level-complete dialog.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin during a dash
verdicts.observed: After dash-down collected a coin, state reports coins=1 but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5', and it remains stale when paused.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so after one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins counter lags behind the coin count (same symptom as HUD coins mismatch)
verdicts.observed: After dash-down+use collected a coin, state coins=1 but HUD shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD catches up only later (1/5 at tick 18), so it lags the real count.
verdicts.expected: The HUD shows the current coin count at all times, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' immediately after the coin is collected. This is the same underlying HUD desync as candidate 9.
